scope: Native1600x256 Severstal steel images; local RTX5060 deployment candidate, not production-camera acceptance

training.early_qualification: once only, from epoch3 after two consecutive epochs with development recall>=0.97 and AUROC>=0.99

policy_selection.learned_fusion: linear C=0.01/0.1/1, mask stats with or without class logits, development five-fold OOF only
policy_selection.unfitted_baseline: raw frozen image head, development only; not called OOF
policy_selection.calibration: 400 normal images; q95/q97.5 selected with development labels
policy_selection.qualification: 986 reused validation images; target gate before one frozen original test1882
policy_selection.simplicity_rule: Prefer raw frozen head when development recall is within0.01 of best fusion candidate and AUROC within0.005. OOF applies only to learned fusion, not to the development-selected CNN.
policy_selection.threshold_safety_rule: Prefer q97.5 calibration if its development recall remains>=0.97 and FPR<=0.05; otherwise maximize eligible development recall. Qualification/test labels never choose the threshold.

findings: Low-contrast thin defects close to strip edges are missed.
Large marked class4 patches are sometimes missed too; resolution alone is insufficient.
Some normal-labeled surfaces contain bright points or coarse texture similar to marked defects. This observation does not establish label error and labels are unchanged.

deployment_preference: User selected local single/batch image inference on this PC
